name: BharatPotHole (associated with iWatchRoad)
publisher: iWatchRoad authors (smlab-niser) — dataset hosted on Kaggle
role_summary: Additional Indian visual pothole evaluation/validation from forward-facing dashcam frames.
version_note: The iWatchRoad repository README (read directly) states the dataset is hosted at the Kaggle URL above and contains 7,000+ annotated frames of forward-facing dashcam footage under diverse lighting, weather and road conditions, and asks users to cite the iWatchRoad paper. Secondary sources: collected over May–July, bounding boxes annotated in Roboflow and exported in YOLO format; a 'BharatPotHole-3K' subset is also mentioned — confirm which release you hold.

data_access.method: Kaggle dataset surbhisaswatimohanty/bharatpothole: attach it as a notebook input and process in place from /kaggle/input (never download it locally).

license.name: NOT STATED in the iWatchRoad README; dataset-page terms NOT READ

evidence.note: The README states how to cite the dataset but gives NO dataset licence.
The repository CODE is licensed CC BY-NC-SA 4.0. This is the code licence: it is NOT assumed to be the dataset's licence.
Official page could not be fetched: the authoring sandbox's network egress proxy blocks this host.

license.attribution: Cite: iWatchRoad: Scalable Detection and Geospatial Visualization of Potholes for Smart Cities (CODS '25 per the README; arXiv 2508.10945 per search results).
notes: Check the Kaggle dataset page's licence field. The repository's NonCommercial code licence is a reason to be cautious about commercial use, not evidence of the dataset's terms.

subset_used: To be chosen. Hold out whole videos/sequences (or directory/index blocks), never random frames.
restrictions: Dataset licence unknown (the repository's software licence is NOT assumed to cover the data): profiling and descriptive runs are allowed; a publishable evaluation is DISABLED until the dataset's own licence/terms are verified at the primary page and recorded on this card.
Do not commit images or annotations.

supports.how: Indian visual pothole evaluation of the provider's vision path (class pothole → roads/pothole) on dashcam frames.
caveats: Dashcam road-view frames, not citizen close-ups.
Frames from one video are near-identical: leakage unless whole groups are held out.
Probably positive-only (every frame has potholes): precision is not meaningful without negatives.

does_not_support.capability: AI-4, text, multilingual, severity, other categories

known_limitations: Annotation format and class names were NOT verified (YOLO per secondary sources); a class-names file is required.
privacy_notes: Dashcam frames may show people and number plates.
expected_schema_notes: YOLO txt labels expected (secondary). Use `profile-images` first; then `prepare --format yolo --class-names-file …`. The adapter never guesses a format or class names.
citation: iWatchRoad: Scalable Detection and Geospatial Visualization of Potholes for Smart Cities (see attribution).
